title: Redeploy the chatticus-marketing pipeline stack (Verify buildspec still installs limatus)
description: The deployed Verify CodeBuild project (chatticus-marketing-verify, account 340169921348) still runs 'pip install pyyaml limatus', so every push to Chattic.us-web main since #36 fails at check_editorial_rules.py (ModuleNotFoundError: humanus) and never reaches Deploy. 'cdk diff ChatticusMarketingPipeline' shows the buildspec change (humanus, check_content_links) plus a policy resource update. Needs a reviewed manual 'cdk deploy ChatticusMarketingPipeline --exclusively' (README, One-time pipeline setup). The 2026-10-21 chattic.us migration was deployed with scripts/deploy-local.sh because of this.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed 2026-10-21 (account 340169921348): ChatticusMarketingPipeline updated through a read change set (7 Modify, no Add/Remove/Replace); Verify now installs humanus. Pipeline execution fab36a3c-9385-4bba-8e6f-f99df80e2178 on Chattic.us-web 1b0ebe7 succeeded at Verify and Deploy; chattic.us serves /, /llms.txt, /feed.xml, /index.md and Accept: text/markdown.
